subject: Re: Lease inquiry - 3100 E 10th St
body: Thanks for reaching out. Base rent is $850 per month, tenant pays utilities. The office and fenced lot are included. Available now.

subject: Re: Permitted use inquiry - 3100 E 10th St (CH)
body: The parcel at 3100 E 10th St is zoned CH (Heavy Commercial). Used motor vehicle sales is a permitted use in CH per Greenville Code sec. 9-4-78 Table 1. A zoning compliance letter can be issued on request.
